# Blindrop

> Blindrop is a blind dating app for Android (India, launching city by city). Once a day it pairs you with one real person for a short, timed conversation by text, voice call or blurred video. Photos and names stay hidden; when time is up both people privately choose Reveal or Pass, and profiles unlock only if both choose Reveal. Adults 18+ only.

Key facts:
- Free to join the daily Drop and talk to your match; optional coins and subscriptions add extras.
- Video calls are live with the camera on, but blurred on the other person's screen until a mutual Reveal.
- Safety: automated message moderation, one-tap report and block, selfie-verified badges.
- Chats without a mutual Reveal are automatically deleted 24 hours after the Drop (reported chats are kept for safety review).
- Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.blindrop.app
- Operated by Tharun Tech Solutions. Contact: support@blindrop.app
